title: HEDFRYLE comforter set
description: HEDFRYLE comforter set, pink, Full/Queen This set offers several color combinations, so you can easily find an expression that suits your bedroom. It also has a wonderfully soft brushed surface – and a surprisingly low price. Easy-care since the comforter can be machine washed and dries quickly.
features: Comprises: 1 Full/Queen size comforter 90x92'' (229x234 cm) and 2 Queen size pillow shams 20x30'' (51x76 cm).
Thread count indicates the number of threads per square inch of fabric. The higher the thread count the more densely woven the fabric.
Filling density is measured in ounces per square yard. The higher the filling density, the fluffier and warmer the comforter.
The roll-packed, compressed comforter regains its original shape and fluffiness after a few days.
materialAndCare: Fabric: 100 % polyester (100% recycled); Filling: 100% polyester (min. 90% recycled)
